newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean students battle riot police in Seoul.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean students battle riot police in Seoul.

text.p: South Korean riot police clashed with about 500 students at a Seoul University on Saturday when the protesters tried to march along a street to demand the resignation of President Kim Young-sam and the arrest of his son, witnesses said.
Riot police fired tear gas to disperse students hurling stones and wielding steel pipes.
The students gathered in Sungkyunkwan University in Seoul to commemorate the 10the anniversary of a student organisation.
"Down with Kim Young-sam. Arrest his son, Hyun-chul," students shouted.

Several of Kim's closest aides are on trial for corruption in connection with a loans-for-kickback scandal surrounding the collapse in January of Hanbo Steel Co, the country's second-largest steelmaker.
No injuries were reported during the demonstration.
